title: reminder-materialization-trigger.v1 (SQS message)
description: BLOCKER-B (reminder-delivery-pipeline.md #4, Codex Round H APPROVED 9.2/10): the SQS message body the reminder-materialization-trigger worker consumes. Deliberately NOT a full SqsCommandEnvelope (schemas/queues/command-envelope.v1.json) - this destination (SQS_REMINDER_MATERIALIZATION_TRIGGER_V1) forwards the bare outbox domain-event payload, so the sender (composition/reminder.ts) folds in only the two envelope fields (tenantId, eventType) the worker actually needs for routing, that its payload doesn't already self-describe. `data` is conditionally validated below against the SAME shape as the corresponding domain event schema's own `data` (item-due-date-changed.v1.json, item-deactivated.v1.json, reminder-policy-changed.v1.json), by $ref into each - never duplicated by hand, so the two can never drift apart silently.
